One real Kensuke longsword, steel blade/gold crossguard; compact practical equipment, no energy cannon.

entries.characterVersion: Marcille Donato, Dungeon Meshi anime2024: adult blond elf mage, long pointed ears, green eyes, long blond hair with twin front braids and small red hair ties, dark blue ankle-length robe with pale beige trim, blue shoulder capelet, red neck ribbon, brown belt pouch, brown sandals over pale leg wraps. Her real Ambrosia wooden staff has a looped natural branch head with small green leaves; no gun, no human Falin likeness.

entries.sourceReference: Senshi sait manier la hache et cuisine pour le groupe ; la récupération alimentaire est une adaptation de ses repas.
entries.characterVersion: Senshi, Dungeon Meshi anime2024 dwarf cook: very stocky muscular adult dwarf, huge dense black beard and moustache, round nose, steel helmet with two short brown horns and cheek guards, bare muscular upper arms, dark sleeveless tunic/leather apron, brown fur-trimmed lower clothes, leather wrist guards, sturdy brown/steel boots. Practical single-headed steel axe carried for ordinary attacks; iron pot and ladle only when actually cooking. No gun, magic wand or elemental attack.

entries.characterVersion: Chilchuck Tims, Dungeon Meshi anime2024, a 29-year-old ADULT male half-foot locksmith, short adult with a slim wiry body and mature narrow face, short reddish auburn hair, brown eyes, rounded protruding half-foot ears, brown quilted sleeveless tunic/vest over cream long-sleeve shirt, brown belt with many small tool pouches, dark brown trousers and brown lace boots. Tiny lock picks and probe tools only, compact brass lock mechanism as work prop. No pistol, rifle, crossbow, dagger attack, child styling or assassin fantasy.

entries.sourceReference: La Falin humaine pratique soin et protection ; ces actions n’importent pas sa transformation imposée.
entries.characterVersion: Falin Touden in her ordinary HUMAN form from Dungeon Meshi anime2024: young adult human woman with short chin-length tousled pale ash-blond bob, soft round face, small HUMAN rounded ears, gentle usually closed/slightly opened eyes, white high-collared long-sleeved ankle-length tunic/robe, simple medium green shoulder cloak/cape secured at neck, brown leather belt and brown boots. No long blond elf braids, pointed elf ears, red ribbon, blue Marcille robe, feathers, dragon body, chimera, tail, wings or transformation. Healer with empty caring hands, no beam cannon or offensive spell weapon.
